acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent mode to automatically switch between MS and MS/MS.
alkylation reagent: alkylated using 50 mM IAA solution for 20 min at 25 °C in the dark.
alkylation concentration: alkylated using 50 mM IAA solution for 20 min at 25 °C in the dark.
cleavage agent: The proteins were digested at 37 °C in wet chamber for 4 h using endoproteinase Lys-C at a 1:50 enzyme-to-protein ratio. After Lys-C digestion, urea was adjusted to 2 M with 50 mM triethyl ammonium bicarbonate. Trypsin (Promega) was added at a 1:50 (enzyme-to-protein ratio) and samples were subjected to a second digestion at 37 °C overnight in wet chamber.
collision energy: The normalized collision energy for CID was set at 35%
enrichment method: enriching the phospho-fraction out of 250 micrograms of purified protein per sample by Ti4-IMAC chromatography coupled with mass-spectrometry.
fragmentation method: the 20 most intense precursors were selected for subsequent decision-tree-based ion trap CID or ETD fragmentation.
instrument: and an LTQ-Orbitrap Elite (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: The electrospray voltage was set at 1.7 kV.
labeling: we aimed to probe the phosphoproteome using a label-free single-shot strategy
reduction reagent: was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 20 min at 56 °C
reduction concentration: was reduced with 10 mM DTT for 20 min at 56 °C
